sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / local planning authorities / Historic England
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 10,958 conservation areas from 157 providers; the collector last ran and new data was last found on 2026-07-20.
sources.quality_effect: Conservation-area intersection can be used as a development constraint only with the explicit warning that the dataset is incomplete and contains duplicates under reconciliation.

sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 190 green-belt records and represents the latest annual-return snapshot, with collector activity on 2026-07-20 and new data last found on 2026-05-10.
sources.quality_effect: Green-belt membership is a strong planning constraint, but the annual snapshot may not reflect boundary changes made after authority returns were submitted.

sources.source: Planning Data flood risk zone dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 780,636 flood-risk-zone geometries from the Environment Agency, but its collector date is 2023-11-01 and new data was last found on 2023-08-24.
sources.quality_effect: Flood-zone intersection remains an official constraint input, but the source age blocks treating it as a current sole-source flood assessment and the zones do not predict certainty or severity of flooding.

sources.source: Planning Data Article 4 direction area dataset
sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / local planning authorities
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 6,997 Article 4 direction areas from 107 providers, with collector and new-data dates of 2026-07-20.
sources.quality_effect: An intersecting area can flag withdrawn permitted-development rights, but mixed-source origin means authoritative order and rule linkage must be checked before a high-confidence parcel penalty.

sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / local planning authorities
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 1,047 current, emerging or historical local-plan records from 63 providers; new data was last found on 2026-07-17.
sources.quality_effect: Local-plan status can gate growth evidence, but the dataset origin warning requires linked authority documents and plan status to be verified before scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data local plan boundary dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 364 local-plan boundaries; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2026-03-18.
sources.quality_effect: The boundary can identify which plan applies to a location, but MHCLG-created geometry must not substitute for an exact site-allocation or canonical parcel relation.

sources.source: Planning Data listed building outline dataset
sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / local planning authorities
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 121,057 listed-building outlines from 93 providers, with collector and new-data dates of 2026-07-18.
sources.quality_effect: The outline can support heritage-constraint screening, but coverage is incomplete and the geometry does not consistently represent listed-building curtilage, so further checks are mandatory.
